summary: One image and a markdown text block side by side: brand story, spotlight, service information.
rules: `image.layout` names the side of the image. In stacks alternate the sides and keep one ratio.
Put the heading inside `content` as `###`, not in `titleText` (a `titleText` floats above both columns, away from its text), unless the preset says otherwise.
Never publish the platform's 1x1 placeholder image; the image comes from upload.
Avoid 10:1 and 7:1 images in a split: they become a sliver.

No raw HTML beyond `
`; links in markdown only to pages that exist.

`titleAlign` is `default` (as in the theme), `left` or `center`: write `default` unless the preset needs a side; a stored `left` under a centred theme is the most common mixed page (`title-align-mixed`).

The columns are a fixed 50/50 split of the section: at a 1400 px theme a section at the theme width gives a text column of 600-900 px, 110-120 characters a line at 14-15 px. Keep a line at 75 characters or less: narrow the section in the theme's box (`section.hPaddingDesktop: "1500"` with `section.isFullscreen: "disabled"`, about 520 px of text; under a theme that spans sections across the screen, `default` follows it and the column runs about 775 px on a 1920 px window) or take the kit-custom-sections pattern `text-media-split`, which sets its own text width and a 16 px body (`story-measure`).
A story block leads further: ImageWithText has no button, so end the text with a markdown link to a real page (the catalog, a collection, the About page) (`story-dead-end`).

presets.name: brand-story-split
presets.use: Home lower half, the native story block: a narrowed section in the theme's box, never across the screen (about 1100 px of content, a text column of about 520 px and 70 characters a line), a `###` heading, one short paragraph and a link on. Reusable on the product page. The custom `text-media-split` is the default story; this one is for a merchant who edits the story in the cabinet.
presets.evidence: 9 stores use exactly one in the lower half of home
fill: `image.file`: image object built from `kit.py media upload` output with `design.py media-object`.
`content`: `### heading` + one paragraph of 300 characters or less from the merchant + a last line with a markdown link to the catalog, a collection or the About page (required: the story leads on).
`image.aspectRatio`: `4:3` (the preset's) beside a short text; `1:1` only for a text of 250 characters or more, otherwise the square leaves the text column half empty.

presets.name: zigzag-first
presets.use: First block of an alternating story stack (about page, landing).
fill: `content`: `### chapter heading` + a paragraph from the merchant.

presets.name: zigzag-next-right
presets.use: Next block of the stack with the image on the right.

presets.name: zigzag-next-left

presets.name: color-block-spotlight
presets.use: One product or novelty as a full-width colour block. On phones the text keeps the theme inset; the colour band still spans the width.
fill: `palette`: a light-tinted or accent palette id of the store.
`content`: eyebrow, product name, one-line claim, 3 benefits, all from the merchant.
